What to look for: in the "Resource Bindings" comment table near the top of the
DXC disassembly, only `samp` (s0) and `usedTex` (t0) are listed. `unusedTex`,
declared at `register(t1)` but never read by `main`, has no row at all --
which is the DCE-driven reflection instability #5105 reports. Compare the
Compiler Explorer options field for the DXC pane: no such option as
`-keep-all-resources` or `-fhlsl-unused-resource-bindings=reserve-all`
(both proposed in still-open, unmerged PRs #7643/#7734) is available here.
